selection_rules: select first, midpoint, and final accepted point of every native branch represented in the provisional run
select every accepted remesh-boundary candidate before restart
select accepted points carrying spine, slice, spine-move, and anchor target contexts
select near-Hopf approach points when terminal evidence reaches them; none are present in this provisional run

validation_contract.coordinate_policy: Python correction/evidence must use the same active physical coordinate recorded by the accepted native point
validation_contract.mesh_policy: selected fixed-mesh native points use identical gauss3/N=32 Python correction meshes; post-remesh native restart is listed separately when no Python same-mesh correction is available
validation_contract.python_correction_backend: independent Python three-stage fixed-parameter correction at identical coordinate
validation_contract.seeding_policy: Python validation seeds come from frozen Python-only branch/fixture evidence; native recorder vectors are fingerprinted but forbidden as solver seeds
